name: Microsoft Visio Desktop MCP Server
description: Creates, reads, updates and validates native Visio diagrams from MCP clients through a local server that automates Visio Desktop on Windows.

skills.name: Create Diagrams
skills.description: Creates native, editable Visio diagrams on an existing page from masters found in installed stencils and templates.

skills.name: Read Diagrams
skills.description: Reads shapes, connections and text from an open Visio drawing so an AI client can analyze or summarize it.

skills.name: Update Diagrams
skills.description: Applies ordered, focused edits to a Visio page and reports each failed, skipped or warned operation.

skills.name: Validate Layout
skills.description: Checks a Visio page for supported visual defects before you share it, without fixing them or judging content.

skills.name: Manage and Export Drawings
skills.description: Opens, creates and saves Visio drawings, manages pages and themes, and exports drawings as an image or PDF.
